definitions.text_mt: Li jindika jew juri li azzjoni ssir b'mod ripetut jew frekwenti, relatat mal-forma verbali li tesprimi azzjoni mtennija

usage_examples.mt: Fil-Malti, il-verb 'tħabbat' huwa eżempju ta' forma frekwentattiva ta' 'tabbat'.
usage_examples.en: In Maltese, the verb 'tħabbat' is an example of a frequentative form of 'tabbat'.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lingwisti jistudjaw il-forom frekwentattivi biex jifhmu kif tinbidel it-tifsira tal-verb.
usage_examples.en: Linguists study frequentative forms to understand how the meaning of the verb changes.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tmur spiss f'post partikolari jew li tattendi regolarment għal xi attività

usage_examples.mt: Huwa frekwentatur assidu tal-librerija pubblika l-ġimgħa kollha.
usage_examples.en: He is a regular frequenter of the public library all week.

usage_examples.mt: Il-każin tan-nies għandu ħafna frekwentaturi lejlet il-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: The social club has many frequenters on weekend evenings.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frekwentaturi tal-iskola tal-isports kienu kollha żgħażagħ.
usage_examples.en: The frequenters of the sports school were all young people.

definitions.text_mt: B'mod frekwenti, spiss jew b'intervalli qosra

usage_examples.mt: Jiena nżur lil ommi frekwentement għax tgħix fil-qrib.
usage_examples.en: I visit my mother frequently because she lives nearby.

usage_examples.mt: Dawn il-kliemiet jintużaw frekwentement fil-lingwa Maltija mitkellma.
usage_examples.en: These words are used frequently in spoken Maltese.

definitions.text_mt: Li jiġri jew iseħħ spiss, li jsir b'intervalli qosra ta' żmien

usage_examples.mt: Il-passaġġi tal-ajruplani huma frekwenti f'dan l-ajruport internazzjonali.
usage_examples.en: Flights are frequent at this international airport.

usage_examples.mt: Il-maltemp huwa frekwenti fix-xitwa fil-gżejjer Maltin.
usage_examples.en: Storms are frequent in winter in the Maltese islands.

definitions.text_mt: In-numru ta' drabi li xi ħaġa sseħħ f'perjodu partikolari ta' żmien
In-numru ta' persuni li jattendu għal xi avveniment, skola, laqgħa jew attività

usage_examples.mt: Il-frekwenza tal-mewġ elettromanjetiku tista' titkejjel bl-hertz.
usage_examples.en: The frequency of electromagnetic waves can be measured in hertz.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frekwenza tal-istudenti fil-klassi tjiebet din is-sena skolastika.
usage_examples.en: Student attendance in the classroom improved this academic year.

usage_examples.mt: Din l-istazzjon tar-radju jxandar fuq frekwenza ta' 100.7 FM.
usage_examples.en: This radio station broadcasts on a frequency of 100.7 FM.

definitions.text_mt: Sar vojt, tilef l-oġġetti, in-nies jew il-kontenut kollu li kellu

usage_examples.mt: Il-klassi friegħet għal kollox wara nofsinhar meta spiċċat il-iskola.
usage_examples.en: The classroom became completely empty in the afternoon when school finished.

usage_examples.mt: Il-pjazza friegħet wara li nfiret l-aħbar tal-attakki.
usage_examples.en: The square became empty after the news of the attacks spread.

definitions.text_mt: Drapp jew materjal li jitqiegħed fuq is-sodda biex jorqdu fuqu, speċjalment il-lożor

usage_examples.mt: Biddilt il-friex tas-sodda llum għax kien maħmuġ wara l-ġimgħa.
usage_examples.en: I changed the bedsheets today because they were dirty after the week.

usage_examples.mt: Tixtri l-friex minn dak il-ħanut li għandu drappijiet tajbin?
usage_examples.en: Do you buy bedding from that shop that has good fabrics?

definitions.text_mt: L-azzjoni ta' meta xi ħaġa ssir vojta, it-tbattil jew l-irtirar tal-baħar mill-kosta waqt il-marea baxxa

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-frigħ tal-baħar, il-blat jibqa' xott u jidher il-qiegħ.
usage_examples.en: After the ebbing of the sea, the rocks remain dry and the bottom is visible.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frigħ tal-ġibjun seħħ bil-mod minħabba n-nixfa.
usage_examples.en: The emptying of the reservoir happened slowly due to the drought.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam ma' konsonanti li tipproduċi ħoss ta' frizzjoni meta tgħaddi l-arja minn fetħa dejqa fil-passaġġ vokali

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħoss 'f' huwa eżempju ta' konsonanti frikativa fil-Malti.
usage_examples.en: The sound 'f' is an example of a fricative consonant in Maltese.

usage_examples.mt: L-għalliema spjegat id-differenza bejn il-konsonanti okklussivi u dawk frikattivi.
usage_examples.en: The teacher explained the difference between plosive and fricative consonants.

definitions.text_mt: Li għadu kemm sar, inġabar, inħasad jew inkiseb, mhux antik u mhux qadim
Li għandu temperatura pjaċevoli baxxa imma mhux kiesħa, li jagħti sensazzjoni ta' frisk

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħobż frisk jinxtamm mill-bogħod meta joħroġ mill-forn.
usage_examples.en: Fresh bread can be smelled from afar when it comes out of the oven.

usage_examples.mt: Il-bajja kienet friska u t-temp kien perfett għal għawma.
usage_examples.en: The bay was cool and the weather was perfect for a swim.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frott frisk huwa dejjem aktar fit-togħma minn dak fil-laned.
usage_examples.en: Fresh fruit is always more flavourful than tinned fruit.

definitions.text_mt: It-tixrid jew il-firxa ta' xi ħaġa fuq wiċċ, l-azzjoni li xi ħaġa tinfirex

usage_examples.mt: Il-frix taż-żerriegħa fir-raba' sar kmieni fir-rebbiegħa.
usage_examples.en: The spreading of the seed in the field was done early in spring.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-frix tal-ħwejjeġ mal-art, in-nixxiefa bdiet taħdem.
usage_examples.en: After the scattering of the clothes on the line, the dryer started working.

definitions.text_mt: Ir-reżistenza li tiġi ġġenerata meta wiċċ ta' oġġett jiżżerżaq fuq wiċċ ieħor, l-attrizzjoni

usage_examples.mt: Il-frizzjoni bejn iż-żewġ biċċiet tal-injam ħolqot biżżejjed sħana biex taqbad nar.
usage_examples.en: The friction between the two pieces of wood created enough heat to start a fire.

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żejt tal-magna jnaqqas il-frizzjoni u jżid il-ħajja tal-magna.
usage_examples.en: Engine oil reduces friction and increases the life of the engine.

definitions.text_mt: Apparat elettriku domestiku użat biex iżomm l-ikel f'temperatura baxxa u jippreservah

usage_examples.mt: Poġġi l-ħalib lura fil-friġġ qabel ma jaqta' bis-sħana.
usage_examples.en: Put the milk back in the fridge before it goes off in the heat.

usage_examples.mt: Għandi bżonn naddaf il-friġġ il-ġimgħa d-dieħla għax fih ikel antik.
usage_examples.en: I need to clean the fridge next week because it has old food in it.

definitions.text_mt: Persuna li tqarraq b'mod intenzjonat u b'qerq biex tieħu flus, proprjetà jew benefiċċji b'mod illegali

usage_examples.mt: Il-frodatur instab ħati u ngħata sentenza ta' sentejn ħabs.
usage_examples.en: The defrauder was found guilty and given a sentence of two years in prison.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frodaturi jużaw diversi metodi sofistikati biex iqarrqu bin-nies.
usage_examples.en: Defrauders use various sophisticated methods to deceive people.

definitions.text_mt: L-azzjoni li tqarraq b'mod diliberat u intenzjonat għal gwadann personali jew biex tikkawża telf lil ħaddieħor

usage_examples.mt: Il-frodi tal-karti tal-kreditu qed tiżdied mal-pajjiż kollu.
usage_examples.en: Credit card fraud is increasing across the whole country.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kumpanija akkużatu b'frodi kontabbli wara l-verifika tal-kontijiet.
usage_examples.en: The company accused him of accounting fraud after the audit of the accounts.

usage_examples.mt: Il-liġi Maltija tikkastiga l-frodi b'mod sever b'multi u priġunerija.
usage_examples.en: Maltese law punishes fraud severely with fines and imprisonment.

definitions.text_mt: In-naħa ta' quddiem ta' xi ħaġa, il-parti li tħares 'il barra jew lejn min iħares

usage_examples.mt: Il-front tal-bini kien imżejjen b'balavostri tal-ġebel.
usage_examples.en: The front of the building was decorated with stone balustrades.

usage_examples.mt: Il-ġellieda marru lejn il-front wara li rċevew l-ordnijiet.
usage_examples.en: The soldiers went to the front after receiving their orders.

definitions.text_mt: Li għandu x'jaqsam mal-front, li jinsab fuq jew jikkostitwixxi n-naħa ta' quddiem

usage_examples.mt: Il-ħabta frontali bejn iż-żewġ vetturi kkawżat ħsara estensiva.
usage_examples.en: The frontal collision between the two vehicles caused extensive damage.

usage_examples.mt: Il-lobu frontali tal-moħħ huwa responsabbli għall-kontroll tal-personalità.
usage_examples.en: The frontal lobe of the brain is responsible for the control of personality.

definitions.text_mt: Il-paġna ta' quddiem ta' ktieb li fiha t-titlu, l-awtur, il-pubblikatur u spiss tiżjin

usage_examples.mt: Il-frontispizju tal-ktieb kien imżejjen b'inċiżjoni sabiħa tas-seklu tmintax.
usage_examples.en: The frontispiece of the book was decorated with a beautiful engraving from the eighteenth century.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frontispizju juri t-titlu, l-awtur u d-data tal-pubblikazzjoni.
usage_examples.en: The title page shows the title, the author and the date of publication.

definitions.text_mt: Struttura arkitettonika ornamentali, ġeneralment trijangolari, fuq in-naħa ta' quddiem ta' bini

usage_examples.mt: Il-frontun tal-katidral kien xogħol ta' l-arti barokki.
usage_examples.en: The pediment of the cathedral was a work of Baroque art.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frontuni tal-binjiet klassiċi Griegi spiss kienu mżejna bi statwi.
usage_examples.en: The pediments of classical Greek buildings were often decorated with statues.

definitions.text_mt: Għodda magħmula minn ċinga jew ħabel imwaħħal ma' manku, użata biex tħeġġeġ lill-annimali jew tikkastiga

usage_examples.mt: Iż-żiemel mexa aktar malajr wara daqqa ta' frosta fuq dahru.
usage_examples.en: The horse walked more quickly after a lash of the whip on its back.

usage_examples.mt: Il-frosta kienet tintuża fil-passat bħala għodda biex tikkastiga lill-iskjavi.
usage_examples.en: The whip was used in the past as a tool to punish slaves.

definitions.text_mt: Prodott li jittiekel minn siġra jew pjanta, ġeneralment ħelu u li fih iż-żerriegħa

usage_examples.mt: Il-frisk huwa importanti ħafna għal saħħa tajba u bilanċjata.
usage_examples.en: Fresh fruit is very important for good and balanced health.

usage_examples.mt: Is-siġra tat-tuffieħ tat ħafna frott din is-sena wara x-xita tajba.
usage_examples.en: The apple tree bore a lot of fruit this year after the good rain.

usage_examples.mt: Nieklu l-frott ma' kolazzjon kuljum b'ċereali u ħalib.
usage_examples.en: We eat fruit with breakfast every day with cereal and milk.

definitions.text_mt: Gwadann jew vantaġġ li wieħed jikseb minn xi ħaġa, profitt
Moviment kontinwu ta' likwidu jew fluwidu, il-mogħdija jew il-kurrent ta' xi ħaġa

usage_examples.mt: Il-froxx ta' din l-investiment kien tajjeb ħafna għall-familja.
usage_examples.en: The benefit of this investment was very good for the family.

usage_examples.mt: Il-froxx tax-xmara kien qawwi wara x-xita qalila tal-jiem li għaddew.
usage_examples.en: The flow of the river was strong after the heavy rain of the past days.

definitions.text_mt: Arma jew għodda b'tliet ponot, użata għas-sajd taħt il-baħar

usage_examples.mt: Is-sajjied uża l-froxxna biex jaqbad il-ħut taħt il-baħar.
usage_examples.en: The fisherman used the harpoon to catch fish underwater.

usage_examples.mt: Il-froxxna għandha tliet ponot li jaqtgħu u tintuża għas-sajd.
usage_examples.en: The trident has three sharp prongs and is used for fishing.

definitions.text_mt: Ikla magħmula minn bajd imsawwat u msajjar fi taġen, spiss mimli bil-ġobon, ħxejjex jew laħam
Sitwazzjoni ta' diżordni, konfużjoni jew taħwid kbir

usage_examples.mt: Għamilt froġa bil-ġobon, it-tadam u l-basal għall-pranzu.
usage_examples.en: I made an omelette with cheese, tomatoes and onions for dinner.

usage_examples.mt: Il-kamra tal-istudju kienet froġa sħiħa wara l-festa ta' għeluq is-sena.
usage_examples.en: The study room was a complete mess after the end-of-year party.

usage_examples.mt: Il-froġa tiegħek ħarġet perfetta u ratba llum, bħal ta' professjonista.
usage_examples.en: Your omelette turned out perfect and soft today, like a professional's.

definitions.text_en: verbal noun of forogħ: ebb, the receding of the sea
definitions.text_mt: L-irtirar tal-baħar mill-kosta, speċjalment waqt il-marea baxxa, it-tbattil tal-baħar

usage_examples.mt: Il-frugħ tal-baħar kien bil-mod dakinhar u ħalla warajh ħafna qxur.
usage_examples.en: The ebbing of the sea was slow that day and left behind many seashells.

usage_examples.mt: Wara l-frugħ, il-bajja kienet mimlija ħut u alka fuq ir-ramel.
usage_examples.en: After the ebb, the bay was full of fish and seaweed on the sand.
